_comment: Which roles may perform each action. Role names are matched case-insensitively. Edit this file to change permissions - no code change needed.
_dashboard_write: May edit shots, statuses and assignments on the dashboard.
_excel_sync: May import from and export to the project Excel backup.
_force_save: May overwrite another user's concurrent edit when a conflict is reported.
_artist_own_status: May set the status of a department row they are personally assigned to, and nothing else. Every artist-type role (the assignable ones) has it.
_artist_statuses: Statuses somebody with only artist_own_status may set. Everything else (Approved, Retake, Omit) is a verdict and stays with the roles in dashboard_write.
_department_scoped: Roles in dashboard_write that may edit only their own department's columns. The department comes from the person's job title.
_manage_leave: Works the leave approval queue at the HR stage, keeps the holiday calendar and closes the leave year.
_manage_it: Works the IT service desk and the IT half of joining and leaving.
_manage_users: Creates, edits and deactivates user accounts on the Users & Roles tab - only giving roles no more powerful than the editor's own.
_view_team_attendance: Sees the whole studio's attendance grid, corrects punches and exports timesheets. Supervisors see their own reports through approve_leave instead.
_ingest_stock: Ingests into and deletes from the stock library.
_approve_leave: Works the first (supervisor) stage of the leave queue.
_manage_permissions: Changes what roles may open and do, on the Permissions screen - only handing on what the editor holds; Full access and the sensitive abilities are Admin/Developer only.
_assignable: May be given work on the dashboard (appears in the Artist pickers).
_dashboard_view_all: Sees every shot of a project on the dashboard (read-only unless they can also edit). Without it, and without dashboard_write, a person sees the shots they are named on.
_schedule_write: Adds, changes and shifts milestones on Scheduling.
_bid_write: Makes and changes bids on Bidding (Won and Lost need approve_bid).
_approve_bid: Marks a bid Won or Lost. Nobody approves their own bid except Admin and Developer.
_delete_project: Archives or deletes a whole dashboard project.
_view_licences: Opens Licences read-only (for people who approve renewals).
_manage_system: Data Center, table editing, the SQL console, purge, Audit Logs and every remote workstation action.
_studio_settings: Studio-wide settings: studio policy, server and database paths, branding and updates.
_tester_destructive: The Tester Panel's destructive tools: wipe, set file dates, the big generators, VACUUM.
_roles_in_database: These lists match role names. A role can also be given any of these actions by ticking it under Abilities on the Permissions screen; that is stored with the role and needs no change here.
